name: Elio
bio: "We built SMMGen on one promise: deliver exactly what we say, every single time." Since founding the company in 2018, Elio has led SMMGen from a small service catalog to a platform processing over 96 million orders for users in 100+ countries - with a focus on operational reliability, transparent pricing, and long-term trust over short-term growth.
